scope: Actual pinned indexed notify/task/ISR/wait/delay; actual list primitives and priority validator, notification actions/previous values/state, ready/delayed wake, pending-ready deferral, wait clear/value/timeout paths, delayed rollover and assertions
limitations: Critical and scheduler suspend/resume calls are explicit fixtures. Blocking waits execute without exception delivery or actual task resumption; memory/control-flow comparisons do not prove temporal scheduling. No composed wrapper graph, physical concurrency or image identity proof.
